title: US Launch Customer: How Seagliders Unlock New Transportation Markets | The Twenty Five & Hornblower
summary: The Twenty Five (XXV), REGENT's U.S. launch customer, and its operating partner Hornblower explain why they're betting on Seagliders.
body_markdown:
At REGENT's Demo Day factory opening ceremony on Sept. 30, 2026, The Twenty Five (XXV), REGENT's U.S. launch customer, and its operating partner Hornblower explain why they're betting on Seagliders. Stan Little, Chairman of The Twenty Five, describes what convinced him after years of meetings with aircraft makers. Stephen Edwards, CEO of Hornblower, covers how the company's experience operating a large harbor fleet fits the Seaglider.


‍
